 prime, then `a**(p-1) ≡ 1 mod p`. As a consequence, we have `a * a**(p-2) ≡ 1 mod p`, which means that
 `a**(p-2)` is the modular multiplicative inverse of a in Fp.

@title OnlyHoldFactory
 @dev Factory contract that deploys creator contracts in one transaction.
 A creator calls `launchCreator()` to simultaneously deploy:
   - An OnlyHoldNFT contract (if NFT membership is desired)
   - An OnlyHoldSubscription contract (if stablecoin sub is desired)
 The factory also serves as the on-chain registry of all creators,
 making it easy to enumerate and verify creator contracts.
 Only verified (non-blacklisted) creators can be registered.
 Platform treasury is set at factory deployment and inherited by all contracts.

@title OnlyHoldNFT
 @dev ERC-721 Membership NFT contract for OnlyHold platform.
 Each creator deploys their own instance of this contract (via OnlyHoldFactory).
 Holding an NFT from this contract grants lifetime access to the creator's

 Revenue flow:

   → 95% goes to creator (owner)
   → 5%  goes to OnlyHold platform treasury

@title OnlyHoldSubscription
 @dev Stablecoin-based subscription contract for OnlyHold platform.
 How it works:
   1. Creator sets a monthly price (e.g. 10 USDC).
   2. Fan deposits any multiple of the monthly price.
      e.g. 30 USDC = 3 months of access.
   3. Access is checked off-chain by reading `getSubscription()`.
      Access is active as long as `expiresAt > block.timestamp`.
   4. Fan can top-up anytime (extends expiry) or withdraw remaining balance
      (cancels remaining subscription).
   5. Creator withdraws accumulated earnings at any time.
 Revenue flow:
   Fan deposits USDC
   → Claimable by creator (95%) when they call `withdrawEarnings()`
   → 5% held for platform fee, claimable by treasury
 Supported stablecoins: USDC, USDT, DAI (or any ERC-20 the creator whitelists).

subscription contract for OnlyHold platform. How it works:   1. Creator sets a monthly price (e.g. 10 USDC).   2. Fan deposits any multiple of the monthly price.      e.g. 30 USDC = 3 months of access.   3. Access is checked off-chain by reading `getSubscription()`.      Access is active as long as `expiresAt > block.timestamp`.   4. Fan can top-up anytime (extends expiry) or withdraw remaining balance      (cancels remaining subscription).   5. Creator withdraws accumulated earnings at any time.
